Fiz os probes materiais. Aqui está o veredito preciso das 3 frentes:

## 1. TikTok 501 — não é bug, é o fail-closed correto

O `501 tiktok_login_not_configured` é exatamente o comportamento que projetei quando faltam os secrets. **Nada a "consertar" no código** — ele está deployado e verificado (smoke 8/8, browser-verify PASS). Para o E2E funcionar, faltam **2 ações rápidas suas** no console (você disse que faz em segundos):

```bash
# P3 — provisionar os secrets (sandbox) no vault das edge fns:
npx supabase secrets set TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY=<seu_client_key_sandbox> TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET=<seu_secret_sandbox>
```
**P1** — no TikTok console, registrar o Redirect URI (path separado do publish, sem query):
`https://bcyvddsykvehvpwstlfa.supabase.co/functions/v1/tiktok-login-callback`

Feito isso, **me avise "secrets prontos"** que eu rodo o **E2E completo via browser-user** (login → consent → `/dashboard`) com Vision QA e te entrego a prova (o screen-record que o app review pede).

## 2. Higgsfield MCP — eu NÃO consigo fazer o E2E ainda (gate real seu)

Testei com JWT do User 0: o `higgsfield-oauth-init` retorna **`higgsfield_client_not_registered`** — o client OAuth no **Clerk ainda não foi provisionado** (`HIGGSFIELD_MCP_CLIENT_ID` não setado). Sem isso, não há URL de consent para o browser-user seguir — é bloqueio duro. **Preciso que você:** registre o client OAuth do MCORCH no Clerk/Higgsfield + set `HIGGSFIELD_MCP_CLIENT_ID`/`HIGGSFIELD_MCP_CLIENT_SECRET`/`HIGGSFIELD_REDIRECT_URI` no vault. Aí eu faço o E2E do "Conectar Higgsfield" via browser + provo o `tools/list`. *(A Platform API key que surfacei nas Settings é a OUTRA conexão — essa já está pronta.)*

## 3. Loop de UX/UI Senior — ótima ideia, e temos as peças

Você já tem tudo espalhado: `vision-qa.ts` (gate Vision), o framework `e2e-user-zero/` (browser-driver + classifier + finding-schema + report), o skill `agent-browser`, `audit-canvas-ui/universe-ui.ts`, e a doutrina MIV. O "Senior UX/UI Loop" seria o **harness que funde isso** num crítico de UX/UI sênior repetível: alvo (rota/flow) → browser-user dirige como revisor sênior (nav, hovers, estados, responsivo) → screenshot por passo → Vision QA + rubrica sênior (hierarquia · consistência · conformidade MIV · acessibilidade · estados vazios/erro/loading · micro-interações · copy pt-BR) → achados estruturados por severidade → e os gates de eng.

Antes de construir (é um harness substancial e quero acertar a forma), uma decisão sua define o que eu codo:

4;\n  const shots = opts.screenshots.filter((s) => existsSync(s.path)).slice(-max);\n  const url = process.env.SUPABASE_URL ?? process.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL;\n  const svc = process.env.SB_SECRET_KEY ?? process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;\n  if (!url || !svc) throw new Error(\"senior-rubric: SUPABASE_URL/SB_SECRET_KEY ausentes no env\");\n  const supa = createClient(url, svc, { auth: { persistSession: false } });\n\n  const findings: Finding[] = [];\n  const gradedLines: SeniorRubricResult[\"gradedLines\"] = [];\n  const keys: string[] = [];\n  try {\n    for (let i = 0; i < shots.length; i++) {\n      const shot = shots[i];\n      const key = `qa-audits/uxui-${opts.runId}-${i}.png`;\n      const up = await supa.storage\n        .from(\"generated-images\")\n        .upload(key, readFileSync(shot.path), { contentType: \"image/png\", upsert: true });\n      if (up.error) {\n        findings.push(buildRubricFinding(opts.flow, shot, { key: \"GRADER\", severity: \"P1\", note: `upload falhou: ${up.error.message}` }, i));\n        gradedLines.push({ step: shot.step, lines: [], readable: false });\n        continue;\n      }\n      keys.push(key);\n      const { data: signed } = await supa.storage.from(\"generated-images\").createSignedUrl(key, 3600);\n      if (!signed?.signedUrl) {\n        findings.push(buildRubricFinding(opts.flow, shot, { key: \"GRADER\", severity: \"P1\", note: \"signed URL falhou\" }, i));\n        gradedLines.push({ step: shot.step, lines: [], readable: false });\n        continue;\n      }\n      const vq = spawnSync(\n        \"bun\",\n        [\"run\", path.join(opts.repoRoot, \"scripts/qa/vision-qa.ts\"), \"image\", signed.signedUrl, SENIOR_RUBRIC_QUESTION],\n        { encoding: \"utf-8\", env: process.env, timeout: 120_000 },\n      );\n      const { lines, readable } = parseSeniorVerdict(vq.status, `${vq.stdout ?? \"\"}${vq.stderr ?? \"\"}`);\n      gradedLines.push({ step: shot.step, lines, readable });\n      lines.filter((l) => l.severity !== \"OK\").forEach((l) => findings.push(buildRubricFinding(opts.flow, shot, l, i)));\n    }\n  } finally {\n    if (keys.length) await supa.storage.from(\"generated-images\").remove(keys).then(() => {}, () => {});\n  }\n  return { findings, judged: shots.length, gradedLines };\n}\n"
}

  "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\n/**\n * audit-journey.ts \u2014 the Senior UX/UI Loop AUDITOR core (SOP docs/processes/ux-ui-senior-loop.md).\n *\n * Walks an END-TO-END user journey (a sequence of stages) with agent-browser, grades EACH screen against the\n * senior UX/UI rubric (Vision MCP) + the objective classifier, and emits one ranked FindingsReport the report\n * pipeline + Knowledge Mesh already understand. This is the auditor half; the auto-fix-loop is the skill-driven\n * orchestration on top (reads findings.json \u2192 fixes \u2192 re-runs this with --stage to re-verify).\n *\n * Reuses verbatim: BrowserDriverImpl, classify(), seniorRubricGate(), buildReport/renderMarkdown/verdictFor,\n * insertFindings(). NEW here is only the journey chaining + per-stage senior grading.\n *\n * Usage:\n *   bun run scripts/qa/ux-ui-senior-loop/audit-journey.ts <journey.json> [--base <url>] [--stage <name>] [--no-vision]\n *   journey.json: { \"name\": \"...\", \"base\": \"https://login.mcorch.com\", \"authStatePath\": \"...\",\n *                   \"stages\": [ { \"name\": \"landing\", \"route\": \"/\", \"steps\": [ {\"label\":\"scroll\",\"waitMs\":800} ] } ] }\n */\nimport { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from \"fs\";\nimport path from \"path\";\n\nimport { BrowserDriverImpl } from \"../e2e-user-zero/lib/browser-driver\";\nimport { classify } from \"../e2e-user-zero/lib/classifier\";\nimport { buildReport, renderMarkdown, verdictFor } from \"../e2e-user-zero/lib/report-renderer\";\nimport { insertFindings } from \"../e2e-user-zero/lib/mesh-persistor\";\nimport type { Finding, ScreenshotRef } from \"../e2e-user-zero/lib/finding-schema\";\nimport { seniorRubricGate } from \"./lib/senior-rubric\";\n\nconst REPO = path.resolve(import.meta.dir, \"../../..\");\n\n// Load .env (SUPABASE_URL, SB_SECRET_KEY, VISION_MCP_PAT) so the grader + persistor + Vision work.\nconst ENV = path.join(REPO, \".env\");\nif (existsSync(ENV)) for (const l of readFileSync(ENV, \"utf-8\").split(\"\\n\")) {\n  const m = l.match(/^([^#=\\s][^=]*)=(.*)$/);\n  if (m && !process.env[m[1].trim()]) process.env[m[1].trim()] = m[2].trim().replace(/^[\"']|[\"']$/g, \"\");\n}\n\ninterface Stage { name: string; route: string; steps?: Array<{ label: string; click?: string; waitMs?: number }> }\ninterface Journey { name: string; base?: string; authStatePath?: string; stages: Stage[] }\n\nfunction arg(flag: string): string | undefined {\n  const i = process.argv.indexOf(flag);\n  return i >= 0 ? process.argv[i + 1] : undefined;\n}\n\nasync function main() {\n  const journeyPath = process.argv[2];\n  if (!journeyPath || !existsSync(journeyPath)) {\n    console.error(\"Usage: audit-journey.ts <journey.json> [--base <url>] [--stage <name>] [--no-vision]\");\n    process.exit(2);\n  }\n  const journey = JSON.parse(readFileSync(journeyPath, \"utf-8\")) as Journey;\n  const base = arg(\"--base\") ?? journey.base ?? \"https://login.mcorch.com\";\n  const onlyStage = arg(\"--stage\");\n  const noVision = process.argv.includes(\"--no-vision\");\n  const stages = journey.stages.filter((s) => !onlyStage || s.name === onlyStage);\n\n  const runId = `uxui-${journey.name}-${Date.now()}`;\n  const outDir = path.join(REPO, \"e2e-output\", runId);\n  mkdirSync(path.join(outDir, \"screenshots\"), { recursive: true });\n\n  const driver = new BrowserDriverImpl({\n    sessionName: runId,\n    authStatePath: journey.authStatePath,\n    commandsLogPath: path.join(outDir, \"commands.jsonl\"),\n    headless: true,\n  });\n\n  const findings: Finding[] = [];\n  const startedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n\n  try {\n    for (const stage of stages) {\n      console.log(`\\n\ud83d\udeb6 Est\u00e1gio: ${stage.name} (${base}${stage.route})`);\n      const screenshots: ScreenshotRef[] = [];\n      const shot = (step: string) => {\n        const p = path.join(outDir, \"screenshots\", `${stage.name}-${step}.png`);\n        driver.screenshot(p);\n        screenshots.push({ path: p, ts: Date.now(), step });\n      };\n      try {\n        driver.open(`${base}${stage.route}`);\n        driver.wait({ load: \"networkidle\" });\n        driver.wait({ ms: 1200 });\n        shot(\"01-initial\");\n        let i = 2;\n        for (const st of stage.steps ?? []) {\n          if (st.click) { try { driver.click(st.click); } catch { /* best-effort */ } }\n          driver.wait({ ms: st.waitMs ?? 900 });\n          shot(`${String(i).padStart(2, \"0\")}-${st.label}`);\n          i++;\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        console.error(`  \u26a0\ufe0f est\u00e1gio falhou ao navegar: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : e}`);\n      }\n\n      // Objective half (console/network) \u2014 the classifier the e2e framework already trusts.\n      let consoleMessages: ReturnType<typeof driver.getConsoleMessages> = [];\n      try { consoleMessages = driver.getConsoleMessages(); } catch { /* tolerated */ }\n      findings.push(...classify({ flow: stage.name, consoleMessages, networkRequests: driver.getNetworkRequests(), screenshots }));\n\n      // Senior half (creative eye + rubric) \u2014 the new lens.\n      if (!noVision && screenshots.length) {\n        const graded = await seniorRubricGate({ flow: stage.name, runId, screenshots, repoRoot: REPO });\n        findings.push(...graded.findings);\n        graded.gradedLines.forEach((g) => console.log(`  \ud83c\udfa8 ${g.step}: ${g.lines.map((l) => `${l.key}=${l.severity}`).join(\" \")}`));\n      }\n    }\n  } finally {\n    try { driver.close(); } catch { /* ignore */ }\n  }\n\n  const report = buildReport({ runId, mode: \"focused\", flows: stages.map((s) => s.name), startedAt, endedAt: new Date().toISOString(), findings });\n  writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, \"report.md\"), renderMarkdown(report));\n  writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, \"findings.json\"), JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));\n  await insertFindings(findings, runId).catch(() => ({ inserted: 0 }));\n\n  const verdict = verdictFor(report.summary);\n  console.log(`\\n\ud83d\udccb ${verdict} \u2014 P0:${report.summary.p0_count} P1:${report.summary.p1_count} P2:${report.summary.p2_count} P3:${report.summary.p3_count} \u00b7 relat\u00f3rio: e2e-output/${runId}/report.md`);\n  process.exit(verdict === \"GO\" ? 0 : 1);\n}\n\nmain().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(3); });\n"
}
```

Login has NO auth.uid() (there is no\n// session yet), so it CANNOT be per-user; it uses the app-GLOBAL credential \u2014 which is that same key. So instead of\n// provisioning a duplicate TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY/SECRET, we read the existing credential from social_app_config.\n//\n// Resolution order: (1) system env override (a dedicated global cred, if ever set) \u2192 (2) the single active tiktok\n// row in decrypted_social_app_config (single-tenant Usu\u00e1rio Zero: that row IS the app owner's = the same key as the\n// connect). Reads via the SAME service-role view (decrypted_social_app_config) the connect's resolveSocialAppCreds\n// already uses \u2014 no new credential surface.\n//\n// \u26a0\ufe0f Multi-tenant note: when the product goes multi-tenant, \"the single active tiktok config\" is no longer the app\n//    owner unambiguously \u2014 a dedicated global cred (env or an app_owner-scoped row) must be used. Tracked for that day.\nimport type { SupabaseClient } from \"https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2\";\n\nexport interface TikTokAppCreds {\n  clientKey: string;\n  clientSecret: string;\n  source: \"env\" | \"social_app_config\";\n}\n\nexport async function resolveTikTokLoginCreds(admin: SupabaseClient): Promise<TikTokAppCreds | null> {\n  const envKey = Deno.env.get(\"TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY\");\n  const envSecret = Deno.env.get(\"TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET\");\n  if (envKey && envSecret) return { clientKey: envKey, clientSecret: envSecret, source: \"env\" };\n\n  const { data } = await admin\n    .from(\"decrypted_social_app_config\")\n    .select(\"client_id, client_secret\")\n    .eq(\"platform\", \"tiktok\")\n    .eq(\"is_active\", true)\n    .limit(1)\n    .maybeSingle();\n  if (data?.client_id && data?.client_secret) {\n    return { clientKey: String(data.client_id), clientSecret: String(data.client_secret), source: \"social_app_config\" };\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n"
}
```

## 🤖 Claude *(22:12:07)*

Assessment claro: o conector Higgsfield hoje = **client app-level (system-env `HIGGSFIELD_MCP_CLIENT_ID`) + token já per-user** (`higgsfield_oauth`). O que você quer (per-user "via UI, na mesma regra") tem um caminho elegante: **DCR (Dynamic Client Registration) por usuário** — no "Conectar", o `oauth-init` registra dinamicamente um client para aquele usuário (a memória confirma "conta = OAuth com DCR"), **eliminando o gate Sovereign** de pré-registrar o client. Mas é um rework de fluxo OAuth (DCR + tabela per-user + migration + /security-review) — um arco focado, não uma correção pequena como a do TikTok.

Vou registrar o design + escopo na memória (não vou fazer o rework de OAuth apressado no fim desta sessão longa — é sensível):

## 🤖 Claude *(22:49:28)*

Isso confirma exatamente o ponto: o login chegou ao TikTok (a chave reusada funcionou!) mas o TikTok rejeitou o **`redirect_uri`** — porque o `tiktok-login-callback` não está registrado. E você tem razão desde o início: **devo reusar o `social-auth-callback` que já está registrado e funcionando**, não criar um novo. Vou fazer isso — o login passa a usar o mesmo callback do connect, distinguido pelo `intent` no state assinado. **Zero ação de console sua.**

Extraindo a lógica do login-callback para um handler compartilhado:

  "content": "// Shared TikTok LOGIN callback handler \u2014 so the login can REUSE the already-registered `social-auth-callback`\n// redirect_uri (no separate console registration). The login is distinguished from the connect by the signed\n// state's `intent: \"login\"` (HMAC-tamper-proof). Called by BOTH social-auth-callback (login branch) and the\n// standalone tiktok-login-callback. The token-exchange redirect_uri MUST match the authorize redirect_uri, so it\n// is a parameter (social-auth-callback for the reuse path). SOP: docs/processes/tiktok-login-oauth.md.\nimport type { SupabaseClient } from \"https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2\";\nimport { verifyState } from \"./oauth-state.ts\";\nimport { resolveTikTokLoginCreds } from \"./tiktok-login-creds.ts\";\n\nconst TIKTOK_TOKEN_URL = \"https://open.tiktokapis.com/v2/oauth/token/\";\n\nasync function sha256Hex(s: string): Promise<string> {\n  const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest(\"SHA-256\", new TextEncoder().encode(s));\n  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, \"0\")).join(\"\");\n}\nfunction randomCode(): string {\n  const bytes = new Uint8Array(32);\n  crypto.getRandomValues(bytes);\n  return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...bytes)).replace(/\\+/g, \"-\").replace(/\\//g, \"_\").replace(/=+$/, \"\");\n}\n\n/** True if the signed state carries a TikTok LOGIN intent (so the connect callback can branch to this handler). */\nexport async function isTikTokLoginState(stateStr: string, stateKey: string): Promise<boolean> {\n  const s = await verifyState<{ intent?: string }>(stateStr, stateKey, { maxAgeMs: 10 * 60 * 1000 });\n  return !!s && s.intent === \"login\";\n}\n\n/**\n * Run the TikTok LOGIN callback: verify state (fail-closed) \u2192 token exchange (redirectUri MUST match authorize) \u2192\n * open_id \u2192 find-or-create identity (NUNCA auto-link by email) \u2192 single-use hand-off code bound to the browser \u2192\n * 302 to the SPA. Returns the Response. Identity-only: TikTok tokens are discarded after open_id.\n */\nexport async function handleTikTokLoginCallback(\n  admin: SupabaseClient,\n  opts: { code: string; stateStr: string; redirectUri: string; appOrigin: string; stateKey: string },\n): Promise<Response> {\n  const { code, stateStr, redirectUri, appOrigin, stateKey } = opts;\n  const redirectTo = (path: string) => new Response(null, { status: 302, headers: { Location: `${appOrigin}${path}` } });\n  const fail = (reason: string) => {\n    const safe = [\"state_expired\", \"not_authorized\", \"exchange_failed\", \"server_error\"].includes(reason) ? reason : \"server_error\";\n    return redirectTo(`/auth?tiktok_error=${safe}`);\n  };\n  const logTelemetry = (event: string, status: string) =>\n    admin.from(\"infra_health_logs\").insert({ service: \"tiktok-login\", event, status }).then(() => {}, () => {});\n\n  try {\n    const state = await verifyState<{ intent: string; nonce: string; ts: number; bh: string }>(\n      stateStr, stateKey, { maxAgeMs: 10 * 60 * 1000 },\n    );\n    if (!state || state.intent !== \"login\" || typeof state.bh !== \"string\" || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(state.bh)) {\n      logTelemetry(\"state_verify\", \"degraded\");\n      return fail(\"state_expired\");\n    }\n\n    const creds = await resolveTikTokLoginCreds(admin);\n    if (!creds) { logTelemetry(\"config\", \"error\"); return fail(\"server_error\"); }\n\n    const tokenRes = await fetch(TIKTOK_TOKEN_URL, {\n      method: \"POST\",\n      headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/x-www-form-urlencoded\" },\n      body: new URLSearchParams({\n        client_key: creds.clientKey,\n        client_secret: creds.clientSecret,\n        code,\n        grant_type: \"authorization_code\",\n        redirect_uri: redirectUri,\n      }),\n    });\n    const tokenData = await tokenRes.json();\n    if (!tokenRes.ok || tokenData.error || !tokenData.open_id) {\n      console.error(\"[tiktok-login] token exchange failed:\", tokenData.error ?? tokenRes.status);\n      logTelemetry(\"token_exchange\", \"error\");\n      return fail(\"exchange_failed\");\n    }\n    const openId: string = tokenData.open_id;\n\n    // Find-or-create keyed STRICTLY on open_id (NUNCA by email \u2014 anti grafting).\n    let userId: string;\n    const { data: existing } = await admin.from(\"tiktok_identities\").select(\"user_id\").eq(\"open_id\", openId).maybeSingle();\n    if (existing?.user_id) {\n      userId = existing.user_id;\n      await admin.from(\"tiktok_identities\").update({ last_login_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq(\"open_id\", openId);\n    } else {\n      const email = `tiktok_${openId}@tiktok-login.mcorch.local`;\n      const { data: created, error: cErr } = await admin.auth.admin.createUser({\n        email, email_confirm: true, user_metadata: { provider: \"tiktok\", tiktok_open_id: openId },\n      });\n      if (cErr || !created?.user?.id) { logTelemetry(\"create_user\", \"error\"); return fail(\"server_error\"); }\n      userId = created.user.id;\n      const { error: iErr } = await admin.from(\"tiktok_identities\").insert({ open_id: openId, user_id: userId });\n      if (iErr) {\n        const { data: raced } = await admin.from(\"tiktok_identities\").select(\"user_id\").eq(\"open_id\", openId).maybeSingle();\n        if (raced?.user_id) userId = raced.user_id;\n        else { logTelemetry(\"identity_insert\", \"error\"); return fail(\"server_error\"); }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Single-use hand-off code bound to the initiating browser (anti login-CSRF), NO tokens in the URL.\n    const oneTimeCode = randomCode();\n    const codeHash = await sha256Hex(oneTimeCode);\n    const { error: codeErr } = await admin.from(\"tiktok_login_codes\").insert({\n      code_hash: codeHash, user_id: userId, binding_hash: state.bh,\n      expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 1000).toISOString(),\n    });\n    if (codeErr) { logTelemetry(\"code_insert\", \"error\"); return fail(\"server_error\"); }\n\n    logTelemetry(\"login\", \"healthy\");\n    return redirectTo(`/auth/tiktok/callback?code=${encodeURIComponent(oneTimeCode)}`);\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error(\"[tiktok-login] callback error:\", err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));\n    logTelemetry(\"callback\", \"error\");\n    return fail(\"server_error\");\n  }\n}\n"
}

Você estava certo desde o começo — e agora está corrigido do jeito que você pediu: **o login TikTok reusa 100% a infra do connect**, sem nenhuma ação de console.

**As duas correções (nenhum token desperdiçado — o código já estava pronto, só apontava errado):**
- **Chave** (`2461fa2`): o login lê a mesma `client_id`/`secret` do `social_app_config` que o `/dashboard/social` já usa.
- **Redirect URI** (`aa7c2a0`): o login usa o mesmo `social-auth-callback` já registrado. Esse callback despacha para o fluxo de login quando vê `intent:"login"` no state assinado (HMAC), antes do fluxo de connect. Lógica extraída para um handler compartilhado; connect intacto.

**Provas:** deno check 4/4 · 3 fns deployadas · init → `redirect_uri=…/social-auth-callback` · smoke fail-closed **8/8** · connect íntegro (state forjado tratado sem crash).

👉 **Tente o "Entrar com TikTok" de novo** — o erro de `redirect_uri` some. Se aparecer `not_authorized`, aí sim é a conta-sandbox (P2), mas como seu connect já funciona com o mesmo app e conta, deve passar direto.

Uma nota honesta (Lei 4): essa mudança tocou o `social-auth-callback` (arquivo sensível). A análise é limpa — o dispatch é gated pelo `intent` assinado (impossível forjar sem a chave), a lógica de login já foi revisada, e um state de connect (sem `intent`) nunca cai no login. Se quiser, rodo um `/security-review` formal do callback mesclado antes de você declarar o login E2E fechado. Me diz como foi a tentativa.
